notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping The Core.
Repeat.

uses.name: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as The Core
